body:
Adds `research/error-feedback-sync`, a companion to `compressed-sync` covering biased sparsification with error feedback in DiLoCo-style local SGD.

- Exact 4x4 second-moment system, closed-form stability limit `2(2-rho)N rho/(N rho^2+4(1-rho))` and closed-form floor (checked against the solved system to 3e-13 and against simulation within 1%).
- Floor returns to the uncompressed one at small steps, where unbiased compression pays 1/rho.
- Dropping is biased to the send-rate-weighted mean; the residual removes the bias at a variance price (crossover near alpha 0.02).
- Top-k comparison is simulation only.
- 9 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok (103 projects). README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
